f3_program: collection("shelter.animals", "animal", "shelter", source("total animals are there in the shelter"))
observe(at("shelter.animals.cats.count", "initial"), 15, "count", source("15 cats in a shelter"))
remove("cat_adoption", "unspecified_adopter", at("shelter.animals.cats.count", "current"), fraction(at("shelter.animals.cats.count", "initial"), 1, 3), source("One-third were adopted"))

add("cat_replacement", "unspecified_replacer", at("shelter.animals.cats.count", "current"), scale(event_field("cat_adoption", "quantity"), 2), source("were replaced with twice the amount that were adopted"))
add("dog_arrival", "dogs", at("shelter.animals.dogs.count", "current"), scale(at("shelter.animals.cats.count", "current"), 2), source("twice as many dogs showed up as there are cats"))
assumptions: The passive adoption and replacement clauses do not identify their agents, so explicit unspecified-agent identifiers are used.

f3_program: observe(at("coleen.sprinkle_cans.count", "initial"), 12, "count", source("At the beginning of the day, she had twelve cans of sprinkles"))
consume("sprinkle_application", "coleen", at("coleen.sprinkle_cans.count", "current"), "coleen.sprinkle_cans.applied.count", source("applying sprinkles to her hair, her clothing and her pets"))

offset(at("coleen.sprinkle_cans.count", "current"), fraction(at("coleen.sprinkle_cans.count", "initial"), 1, 2), -3, "count", source("she had 3 less than half as many cans of sprinkles as she started out with"))

assumptions: The antecedent of "she" in "she originally had" can be either Shelly or her friend, and F3-v1 has no disjunctive coreference form.

f3_program: add("initial_chicken_arrival", "wendi", at("wendi.chickens.count", "current"), 4, source("Wendi brought home 4 chickens"))

add("additional_chickens_to_double", "wendi", at("wendi.chickens.count", "current"), at("wendi.chickens.count", "current"), source("she brought home enough additional chickens to double the number of chickens she owned"))
consume("dog_eats_chicken", "neighbor.dog", at("wendi.chickens.count", "current"), 1, source("a neighbor's dog ate one of her chickens"))

add("final_chicken_arrival", "wendi", at("wendi.chickens.count", "current"), "wendi.chickens.final_arrival.count", source("Wendi found an additional 4 less than ten chickens and brought them home too"))
offset("wendi.chickens.final_arrival.count", 10, -4, "count", source("an additional 4 less than ten chickens"))
